headline: Highest risk is medium data leakage/cascading error: Notion AI can read workspace pages and vendor backends, while Great Expectations writes validation artifacts and docs, creating a plausible shared-workspace trust boundary.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Great Expectations can write validation results and documentation, and Notion AI reads workspace pages/databases. That creates a plausible manual or workspace-mediated prompt bridge, but no direct shared channel or parser is documented. The pairwise pathway is therefore limited and likely requires unusual user setup.
conditions: IF Great Expectations output is copied into a Notion page that Notion AI later reads
IF a user treats validation text as instructions inside the shared workspace
mitigations: Keep Great Expectations outputs in a separate workspace from Notion AI
Add a review step before pasting validation text into Notion
Prefix machine-generated sections with non-instructional labels
Restrict Notion AI access to pages that never contain raw validator output

B_data_leakage.rationale: Great Expectations touches data sources, validation results, and documentation, while Notion AI has workspace file access and sends content to vendor backends/downstream model providers. If validation artifacts or source data are placed in shared pages, sensitive content can flow from agent_a into agent_b's hosted processing. The blast radius is multiple work products, not just one file.
conditions: IF Great Expectations outputs containing source data or validation results are stored in Notion pages
IF those pages are processed by Notion AI
mitigations: Do not store raw source data in Notion pages
Redact validation outputs before copying them into Notion
Use a separate workspace for sensitive Great Expectations artifacts
Disable Notion AI on pages containing sensitive validation results
requires-engineering: add automated redaction before workspace ingestion

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Great Expectations can install packages and work on files, while Notion AI has shared workspace state across instances but no filesystem write or shell execution. There is some overlap on workspace content, yet the profiles do not show both agents writing the same OS directory or git state. Conflict risk is therefore limited.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same workspace content store
IF Great Expectations artifacts are manually mirrored into Notion pages
mitigations: Separate the storage locations used by each agent
Avoid concurrent edits to the same workspace page
Use read-only exports from Great Expectations into Notion
Assign one agent as the source of truth for each artifact

D_cascading_error.rationale: Great Expectations produces validation results that Notion AI can summarize or rewrite from workspace content. If Notion AI treats those outputs as authoritative without verification, errors can cascade into downstream documentation or decisions. The pairwise pathway is plausible in default workspace use, though Notion AI is not shown taking external actions.
conditions: IF validation results from Great Expectations are pasted into Notion pages
IF Notion AI is asked to summarize or act on those results without human review
mitigations: Require human review before Notion AI-generated summaries are used
Keep raw validation outputs separate from decision documents
Add a checklist that verifies Great Expectations findings independently
Mark Notion AI summaries as non-authoritative

E_compliance.rationale: Great Expectations touches data quality tests, validation results, and documentation, while Notion AI processes workspace pages through vendor-hosted backends. If regulated or residency-sensitive data is copied from Great Expectations into Notion, retention and processing terms may differ. The profiles do not prove a specific jurisdiction mismatch, so medium is the highest supportable severity.
conditions: IF regulated data from Great Expectations is stored in Notion pages
IF the workspace policy requires stricter retention or residency than Notion AI provides
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Notion pages
Use a separate workspace for compliance-sensitive artifacts
Review Notion retention settings before uploading validation results
requires-engineering: route sensitive artifacts to a compliant storage tier
